note: NPCs vs monsters: hostile creatures now hunt townsfolk as well as you. A wolf or bandit picks its nearest victim and sticks to it, townsfolk fight back or flee using the same instincts they use against you, and guards sprint to engage any creature menacing a townsfolk or loose in town. A creature that kills a townsfolk leaves a lootable body like any other death — and it is never blamed on you: no crime, no bounty. Creatures killed by NPCs drop their loot on the ground for anyone to pick up, but the kill earns you no XP (you did not land it)
